The '''RapidResponse police speeder''' was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|civilian/police]] variant of the military [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeder]] and was used by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] as a [[police speeder]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:PoliceBARCspeederbike.png|thumb|left|220px|Two police droids on speeders]]
The RapidResponse Speeder had a dark, blue and gray paint scheme. Flashing red and blue lights were fixed near the aft and stern thrusters. On the rear was the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] symbol.<ref name="SWBftG" />

The speeders were powered by repulsors and a turbine engine mounted on the frontal prong. The speeder was controlled via twin steering vanes atop the bike and pedals fitted below. Two blaster cannons protruded from the bottom of the forward prong.<ref name="SWBftG" />

==History==
The RapidResponse [[police speeder]] was based on the [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeder]] utilized by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Originally developed for military use by [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]], the BARC speeder saw such great success that Aratech repackaged it for [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] use on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Mostly, they were driven by CSF [[Police droid/Legends|police droids]].<ref name="SWBftG" />

[[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] rode a borrowed speeder to a train station to catch [[Ione Marcy/Legends|Ione Marcy]] and [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]] via [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] cleverly placed on Marcy's back by Sinube.<ref name="LL">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref>

When it appeared [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] had [[Death/Legends|murdered]] [[Davu Golec/Legends|Davu Golec]] CSF police droids used the speeders to pursue a civilian [[RGC-16 airspeeder/Legends|RGC-16 airspeeder]] which the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guards]] thought she was escaping in.<ref name="DoM">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref>

The speeders were also used to chase down [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] when she was escaping from an assassination attempt by two thugs, [[Chata Hyoki/Legends|Chata Hyoki]] and [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]].<ref name="PoP">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Underworld_Police_speeder_concept.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Police speeder concept]]
The RapidResponse police speeder was designed for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. It first appeared in the episode ''[[Lightsaber Lost]]'' where Master Sinube and Jedi Tano borrow it from one of the police droids. The speeder would later appear in subsequent episodes including ''[[Duchess of Mandalore]]'', ''[[Pursuit of Peace]]'', ''[[Senate Murders]]'', and ''[[To Catch a Jedi]]'' where it would be used by the Coruscant Security Forces as a patrol and pursuit speeder. A concept art image of the RapidResponse speeder for use by the [[Coruscant Underworld Police]] in the cancelled ''[[Star Wars: 1313]]'' game, appeared in ''[[Star Wars Art: Concept]]'' which was published on [[October 15]], [[2013]].
